scripts.lint: eslint . && uv run ruff check python
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run ruff format python
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && uv run ruff format --check python
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r typecheck && uv run mypy python
scripts.check: pnpm build && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm format:check
